My Komodo post seemed to go over well, so I figured I'd post some shots from Tioman in Malaysia.

Tioman is a small island at the bottom of Malaysia in Johor. It's classified as a duty free island so it's got super cheap booze. It's also a marine reserve so no resorts, just a handful of villages scattered down the coast. As a westerner, I prefer ABC (Telok Ayer Batang). Most of the beaches cater to a particular ethnic group. Also be careful, if you try to stay at the bottom near the twin peaks, you'll be staying in a Malay village with no booze and 200rm(65usd) a boat ride back to where you can go diving. I usually dive with B&J. They are a good crew and most people have been there for multiple seasons and know the area quite well. There are maybe another 5-8 dive shops on the island though. The dive sites are close enough to shore that you go out and dive, come back for a few hours and then go back out. This is great because you can be a bit more picky about where you go and what you want to do. Dives cost about 100rm (30usd) a dive and there are typically 3 a day and a night dive if there are enough people.

Stuff to see: There's a wreck. The house reef has a treadmill. There isn't a crazy amount of rare things, but there is a good amount of life, pretty clear water and nice coral. It's a very chill place.
